recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current core source satisfies the issue request; any further wording cleanup in NutritionProduct would be editorial and should not be treated as required FHIR-32294 reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-32294 was a Published/Persuasive R5 ballot issue asking whether NutritionIntake existed because the 2021 May NutritionProduct page referred to it while the ballot resource list and NutritionProduct page did not make the resource discoverable/linkable.
initial_application: NutritionIntake source/build registration was added by bc846f6893 in 2019, and f246497111 in 2022 added NutritionIntake entries to source/resourcelist.html. No source commit explicitly keyed to FHIR-32294 was found, matching the Jira/OO-minutes conclusion that the issue was pre-applied by the time of R5 reconciliation.
additional_context: OO HCP minutes on 2023-01-09 state that the resource exists, is in the listing/CI build, and the remaining concern was Jira visibility. OO minutes on 2023-02-10 record the 10-0-0 motion to find FHIR-32294 persuasive and pre-applied for R5. Current source also includes a Nutrition module page with NutritionIntake links.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source/fhir.ini actively includes nutritionintake=NutritionIntake, source/nutritionintake/structuredefinition-NutritionIntake.xml defines the resource, source/resourcelist.html lists NutritionIntake in categorized and alphabetical lists, and source/nutritionproduct/nutritionproduct-introduction.xml links to nutritionintake.html.

related_jiras.note: OO minutes discussed R4 nutrition-intake representation and recommended Basic/profiles until R5 NutritionIntake is available; this supports context that NutritionIntake is the R5 path but does not require a current source change for FHIR-32294.
